description: This Java source file implements the Hibernate-based Data Access Object (DAO) for HL7 message handling in the OpenMRS system, including methods for CRUD operations on HL7 sources, queues, archives, and errors, along with search and batch retrieval functionalities.

classes.name: HibernateHL7DAO
classes.description: Hibernate implementation of HL7DAO interface providing data access methods for HL7 message sources, queues, archives, and errors.

methods.name: setSessionFactory
methods.description: Set the Hibernate session factory used for database operations.

methods.name: saveHL7Source
methods.description: Persist or update an HL7 source entity.

methods.name: getHL7Source
methods.description: Retrieve an HL7 source by its identifier.

methods.name: getHL7SourceByName
methods.description: Retrieve an HL7 source by its name.

methods.name: getAllHL7Sources
methods.description: Retrieve all HL7 sources.

methods.name: deleteHL7Source
methods.description: Delete a specified HL7 source.

methods.name: saveHL7InQueue
methods.description: Persist or update an HL7 message in queue.

methods.name: getHL7InQueue
methods.description: Retrieve an HL7 message in queue by ID.

methods.name: getHL7InQueueByUuid
methods.description: Retrieve an HL7 queue message by its UUID.

methods.name: getAllHL7InQueues
methods.description: Retrieve all HL7 queue messages with pending status, ordered by ID.

methods.name: getHL7Batch
methods.description: Retrieve a batch of HL7 entities matching search criteria, supports pagination.

methods.name: countHL7s
methods.description: Count HL7 entities matching search criteria.

methods.name: getNextHL7InQueue
methods.description: Retrieve the next pending HL7 message in queue.

methods.name: deleteHL7InQueue
methods.description: Delete an HL7 message from queue.

methods.name: saveHL7InArchive
methods.description: Save or update an HL7 archive record.

methods.name: getHL7InArchive
methods.description: Retrieve an HL7 archive record by ID.

methods.name: getHL7InArchiveByState
methods.description: Retrieve HL7 archive records by message state.

methods.name: getHL7InQueueByState
methods.description: Retrieve HL7 queue messages by message state.

methods.name: getAllHL7InArchives
methods.description: Retrieve all HL7 archive records, with optional maximum results limit.

methods.name: deleteHL7InArchive
methods.description: Delete an HL7 archive record.

methods.name: saveHL7InError
methods.description: Save or update an HL7 error record.

methods.name: getHL7InError
methods.description: Retrieve an HL7 error record by ID.

methods.name: getHL7InErrorByUuid
methods.description: Retrieve an HL7 error record by UUID.

methods.name: getAllHL7InErrors
methods.description: Retrieve all HL7 error records.

methods.name: deleteHL7InError
methods.description: Delete an HL7 error record.

methods.name: garbageCollect
methods.description: Clear Hibernate session context.

methods.name: getHL7InArchiveByUuid
methods.description: Retrieve an HL7 archive record by UUID.

methods.name: getHL7InArchivesToMigrate
methods.description: Retrieve HL7 archive records eligible for migration based on retention policy.
